market_summary: US markets are digesting a wave of AI-adjacent earnings reactions: Broadcom's soft guidance triggered a sympathy sell-off across custom-silicon names (MRVL), and cybersecurity got caught in Palo Alto's post-earnings rout (CRWD). Meanwhile Nasdaq slid on Hyperliquid market-entry rumors and copper names like FCX pulled back sharply despite an intact secular AI-datacenter demand story. No open position breached its stop-loss today and no BULL analysis candidates exist outside the current 12 holdings, so today's decision is to hold across the board while individual stops manage downside risk.
